title: DepEd mourns deaths of 2 students in Cauayan City fun run

blocks.text: CAUAYAN CITY — The Schools Division Office of Cauayan City has expressed deep sorrow over the deaths of two learners who were electrocuted during a bubble fun run at Cauayan South Central School on Saturday, Oct. 3. The victims were a 7-year-old girl and an 8-year-old boy. “We mourn the loss of two learners and extend our deepest sympathies to their families and our sincere concern and support to those affected,” Schools Division Superintendent Cherry Ramos said in a public statement.
